title: Reading Order, Alt Description & Text Projection
objective: Provide explicit reading order, transcript/text-only projection, alt descriptions and accessibility-equivalent controls/state for sequential-art projects without rewriting authored visual, dialogue, narrative or owner-domain truth.
acceptance: Reading order is explicit and stable across pages, panels and relevant text elements rather than inferred from visual coordinates.
Text-only/transcript projection preserves authored dialogue/text identity, ordering and source references without becoming a second dialogue or narrative authority.
Alt descriptions are explicit presentation/accessibility metadata with stable target identity and do not silently redefine visual, Character, Scene or narrative truth.
Accessibility-equivalent controls expose the same reachable authoring/reading state without requiring drag, pointer-only interaction or audio.
Missing or stale referenced source state fails the affected projection closed without fabricated text, descriptions or repaired owner truth.
Provider-off local visual/text accessibility remains supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-18 and later packaging/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-17 owns reading-order and accessibility projections only; Dialogue, Character, Scene, narrative, AAI and ARI domains retain their canonical authorities.
Alt descriptions and transcript/text projection are presentation/accessibility metadata and may not silently alter authored source text or canonical owner truth.
Audio remains optional; accessibility-equivalent operation cannot depend on SAA-16 audio availability.
No packaging, sharing/publication, final Creator integration or automatic semantic rewriting authority is granted.
SAA-18 remains blocked until verified SAA-17 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-17.
